office_macro_spawn_powershell: Office application spawning PowerShell - common macro execution chain.
powershell_encoded_command: PowerShell launched with an encoded command parameter (possible obfuscation).
orphan_process_without_parent_metadata: Process lacks expected parent metadata - may indicate tampering or telemetry loss.
signed_to_unsigned_transition: Signed parent spawning unsigned child binary - potential living-off-the-land or dropper behavior.
ja3_novel: Previously unseen JA3 TLS client fingerprint (novel client behavior).
ja3_rare: Low-frequency JA3 fingerprint in environment baseline.
corr_office_ps_rare_ja3: Correlation: Office macro PowerShell spawn combined with rare JA3 TLS client.
corr_encoded_ps_signed_to_unsigned: Correlation: Encoded PowerShell plus signed→unsigned transition - elevated suspicion.
exfil_volume_high: Outbound data transfer volume exceeding heuristic threshold.
dns_tunnel_pattern: DNS query patterns consistent with tunneling (length/structure heuristic).
suspicious_parent_child_pair: Known suspicious parent→child process execution chain indicative of potential macro or LOLBin abuse.
beacon_low_jitter: Network destination exhibiting low jitter periodic connections (possible beacon).
beacon_periodic: Sustained periodic outbound connections with stable interval suggesting C2 beacon behavior.
non_sbom_component_exec: Execution of a binary not present in the provided SBOM component inventory (potential shadow or dropped binary).
component_hash_drift: Observed process hash differs from SBOM-declared canonical hash (possible tampering or version drift).
egress_volume_spike: Outbound bytes exceed EWMA-based anomaly threshold (sudden egress spike).
new_domain_seen: First observation of this domain within novelty window (potential staging/bootstrap).
cmd_rare_token_spike: Command line contains unusually high ratio of rare tokens (possible obfuscation or generated payload).
